content.title: RCB vs CSK Highlights, IPL 2026: Royal Challengers Bengaluru wins by 43 runs as Chennai Super Kings stumbles to third straight defeat
content.text: Home Cricket IPL IPL News RCB vs CSK, IPL 2026: Follow for all updates and highlights of the IPL match between Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Chennai Super Kings, which was held at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday. Updated : Apr 05, 2026 23:41 IST Royal Challengers Bengaluru's Bhuvneshwar Kumar celebrates after taking the wicket of Chennai Super Kings' Ayush Mhatre. | Photo Credit: REUTERS Royal Challengers Bengaluru's Bhuvneshwar Kumar celebrates after taking the wicket of Chennai Super Kings' Ayush Mhatre. | Photo Credit: REUTERS Hello and welcome to Sportstar’s Highlights of the IPL 2026 match between Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Chennai Super Kings on Sunday, April 5.Welcome to Sportstar’s coverage of IPL match between Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Chennai Super KingsRoyal Challengers Bengaluru250 / 3 (20 OV)Chennai Super Kings207 (19.4 OV)Royal Challengers Bengaluru win by 43 runsFOR SCORECARD CHECK MATCH CENTRE RCB on top, CSK at the bottom It is a similar tale as last year, with defending champion RCB on top and CSK languishing at the bottom of the standings. Though CSK did manage to get to 207, it just couldn’t match Tim David’s whirlwind innings (70 not out off 25 balls) to saw RCB plunder 97 runs in the last five overs. CSK had a disastrous start, losing three wickets inside the PowerPlay. The only time CSK even looked like it had a tiny foothold in the game was when Sarfaraz Khan was in the middle. He struck 50 off 25 balls before being undone by Krunal Pandya. Prashant Veer and Jamie Overton also briefly raised CSK’s hopes with a 57-run stand off 32 balls, but there was just too much left to do for the lower middle-order batters. CSK has plenty to ponder, having fallen to its third straight defeat, while RCB seems to have picked up from where it left off last year. That will be all from us for tonight. Make sure you join us for tomorrow’s game! Not a lucky 7 for CSK! CSK’s Ruturaj Gaikwad loses 7 consecutive matches as IPL captainRuturaj Gaikwad registered seven consecutive losses as a captain after Chennai Super Kings lost to Royal Challengers Bengaluru at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru on Sunday. What is CSK's biggest defeat in IPL? IPL 2026: What is CSK’s biggest defeat in IPL history?Discover CSK's biggest defeat in IPL history and its struggle during the 2026 season against RCB. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 207 in 19.4 overs Abhinandan to bowl the final over. A full toss followed by a yorker and just a single each for Kamboj and Henry. Short, and Kamboj gets a leading edge that lands wide of the bowler. OUT! Henry holes out at deep square-leg and that’s it! RCB wins by 43 runs and CSK is consigned to its third consecutive defeat this season. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 204/9 in 19 overs Duffy to bowl out. He starts off with a wide. FOUR! Bouncer and Kamboj gets a top edge over the keeper and the ball races to the boundary. SIX! This was short again and Kamboj slams this over deep square for a maximum. 13 runs from it, and CSK will be happy to get past 200! RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 190/9 in 18 overs Bhuvneshwar bowls out. Kamboj thumps a slower ball down the ground for a single. Noor hacks across the line but cannot make a good connection. SIX! In the slot and carted over long-on by Noor for a maximum. Width outside off and sliced to deep point by Noor for one more. Hard length outside off and just a single for Kamboj at long-off. Too short and called a wide for height. OUT! Short outside off, and Noor slaps this and is caught by Kohli at long-on. Noor Ahmad c Virat Kohli b Bhuvneshwar Kumar 8 (8b 1x6) RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 180/8 in 17 overs OUT! Suyash gets his first wicket. Launched high in the air by Overton and taken at lon-off. Noor Ahmad is in at No. 10. He starts off with a single. DROPPED! Abhinandan Singh drops a sitter at short third and Kamboj gets away with it. A couple of dot balls now, and Suyash continues to keep it very tight. Third dot ball in a row as Suyash bowls it quicker on the pads. Excellent spell comes to an end. Jamie Overton c sub (Jacob Bethell) b Suyash Sharma 37 (16b 4x4 2x6) RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 178/7 in 16 overs OUT! Bhuvneshwar comes back and strikes first ball. Prashant was looking to drive this on the up but Patidar takes an excellent diving catch at extra-cover. Good knock comes to a end. Time for a strategic timeout. Anshul Kamboj the new man in. He gets a leading edge but the ball lands safely between two fielders in the extra-cover region. He picks a single. FOUR! Width outside off and slashed to the cover boundary by Overton. FOUR! Flicked away to the square-leg boundary now by Overton. It is also a no-ball as Bhuvi has overstepped. Free-hit loading! Good full delivery outside off and just a single for Overton at long-off. One more through the leg-side for Kamboj. Good yorker to end the over and just a single for Overton. Prashant Veer c Rajat Patidar b Bhuvneshwar Kumar 43 (29b 6x4 1x6) RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 165/6 in 15 overs Suyash will continue. Single for Overton through leg-side. Punched to cover by Prashant, and a misfield by Krunal allows him to take a single. Shortish and slashed to deep extra cover for a single by Overton. FOUR! Thumped down the ground by Prashant for a boundary. Prashant goes for the sweep and misses. Loud appeal for lbw but not given. RCB doesn’t take the review. Another single to end the over and just eight runs from it. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 157/6 in 14 overs FOUR! Krunal gives width outside off stump and Prashant cashes in by sending the ball crashing to the cover boundary. SIX! This is again going outside off but Prashant clubs it over long-on for a big maximum. FOUR! Prashant shuffles across, and then wristily flicks it through midwicket for another boundary. Finally a dot ball for Krunal. FOUR! Outside off again, quite wide, and Prashant toe ends it past the keeper and to the boundary. Loud stumping appeal after Krunal goes for the bouncer. Prashant did well to get his hand back inside the crease, because he had lost his bat. He survives. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 139/6 in 13 overs Suyash continues. Steered behind point with soft hands by Prashant for a dot ball. Beaten! Googly turning away from Prashant, who misses trying to dab the ball through third-man. Tucked away through midwicket for a single by Prashant. Cut away through point by Overton for one more. Third dot bal in the over, and excellent bowling by Suyash. He gets away with that one. It was short outside leg-stump but Prashant could only tug it to short fine for a single. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 136/6 in 12 overs Romario Shepherd comes into the attack. A single for Prashant off the first ball. SIX! Hard length and Overton tugs that away over deep midwicket for a maximum. SIX! Short outside off and slapped by Overton over long-off this time for consecutive sixes. FOUR! Short again, and Overton pulls this behind square-leg and finds the boundary. Drilled down the ground by Overton for a couple more. Kohli puts in a good dive in the deep to save a boundary. Slashed away hard through covers by Prashant but it’s just a single to end the over. RCB vs CSK Live Score: CSK 117/6 in 11 overs Impact Player Suyash Sharma into the attack. Overton tucks it through square-leg for a single. Tucked away for one more through square-leg by Prashant off the next ball. FOUR! Thick outside edge as Overton looks to slap it through covers and the ball runs away to the third-man boundary. Pulled to deep midwicket by Overton for a single. Angling away outside off and Prashant steers it behind point for a dot ball. Pushed to wide long-on by Prashant for a single to end the over. CSK 109/6 in 10 overs Abhinandan to continue. Prashant steers the ball towards midwicket and takes a single. Dube gives him the strike back. Prashant takes a single again. Dube plays a dot then. OUT! Dube is gone. Went for the slog, gets an under edge and Jitesh takes a brilliant catch. Dube has to go for 18 off 13 balls. Jamie Overton in at eight. Takes a single. CSK 105/5 in 9 overs Krunal begins with a short ball and Prashant steers it away past the point fielder for four!A single off the next ball and Dube is on strike. Another bouncer and Dube leaves it. Quick and short from Krunal. Now Krunal just bowls a low release delivery and Dube takes a single. Prashant gives Dube the strike back. Short ball, Dube gets a top edge and it goes over the keeper for four! RCB vs CSK live score: CSK 94/5 in 8 overs Abhinandan continues. Dube takes a single off the first ball. Four! Prashant pulls the ball towards fine leg and gets a four. Takes a single off the next ball. Full toss and Dube hammers it straight past mid off for four! A dot next ball. Dube tries to go for a big hit, swing and a miss to end the over. CSK 84/5 in 7 overs Krunal Pandya into the attack. OUT! Sarfaraz comes down the track and is beaten by pace. Jitesh Sharma does the rest. Sarfaraz is stumped. Wicket off the first ball for Krunal. Sarfaraz goes for 50 off 25 balls. Shivam Dube in at six. He smacks the first ball for a maximum. Slog sweeps and ball is gone way into the stands. Bouncer by Pandya! Umpire gives the first warning. Importantly, a dot. Another short ball and Dube takes a single. OUT! Kartik goes for a slog sweep and ends up hitting high in the air. An easy catch at short third. Two wickets in one over for Krunal. Prashant Veer in at seven. A bouncer to end the over. RCB vs CSK live score: CSK 77/3 in 6 overs Abhinandan Singh into the attack. Sarfaraz chases an outside off ball and misses it and loses his bat as well. Sarfaraz now upper cuts towards deep point and gets a double. FOUR! On the pads and Sarfaraz flicks it towards square leg for four! Another four! Sarfaraz lofts his cover drive and gets another boundary. This is a very nice batting display by Sarfaraz. Sarfaraz now lofts over mid on and gets a double. Sarfaraz takes a single towards midwicket and reaches his fifty off just 24 balls. Splendid fifty. RCB vs CSK live score: CSK 64/3 in 5 overs Duffy for his third over. Starts off with a wide delivery. Patidar has reviewed the decision! Splendid review, the ball brushed the thigh pad. Sarfaraz pulls the short ball and it goes for a six! Very nicely timed shot that. Duffy follows it up with a down the leg wide. Another short ball and Sarfaraz pulls it towards square leg for another four. An lbw appeal but umpire is not interested. Another four! Sarfaraz once again picks the length ball towards square leg for four. It’s a no ball as well! High full toss but only a single off the free hit. SIX! Kartik Sharma gets into the act. Picks the length ball and lofts it away towards midwicket. CSK 41/3 in 4 overs Bhuvneshwar for his second over. Sarfaraz defends the first ball. Short ball and Sarfaraz lofts it over mid on and gets a four! Defends the next ball towards leg side. Gets squared up the next ball and beaten off the outside edge. SIX! Picks the leg side delivery and sends the ball over the square leg boundary, Sarfaraz. An lbw appeal but umpire is not interested. Sarfaraz steals a single although he loses the bat in process. CSK 30/3 in 3 overs Duffy with the length ball and Samson tries to pull it but doesn’t time it well. The fielder at midwicket is a bit behind and isn’t able to catch it. Lucky. Sarfaraz gets an outside edge towards deep third and Bhuvneshwar Kumar isn’t able to stop it from going to the fence. Four runs. Sarfaraz takes a single next ball. SIX! Short ball and Samson picks the ball over fine leg boundary for a maximum! Terrific shot. OUT! Samson gets an outside edge and Padikkal grabs another easy catch at first slip. Samson once again can’t get past the single digit. Goes for 9 off 5 balls. Kartik Sharma in at five, he’s the impact player. Defends the first ball. RCB vs CSK live score: CSK 18/2 in 2 overs Bhuvneshwar Kumar from the other end. Mhatre defends the first ball. OUT! Mhatre is gone as well. Length ball and he ends up hitting it straight mid off. An easy catch. 200 wickets for Bhuvneshwar Kumar in IPL! Mhatre goes for 1. Sarfaraz Khan in at four. Begins his innings with a brilliant cut shot for four! Comes down the track but gets beaten by length, Sarfaraz. Another dot as Sarfaraz defends the next ball. Gets an outside edge and Padikkal can only get his finger tips to the ball which goes towards the boundary for four! RCB vs CSK live score: CSK 10/1 in 1 over Jacob Duffy to bowl the first over. Sanju Samson and Ruturaj Gaikwad open the innings. Samson on strike. He tucks the ball towards square leg and takes a single first ball. Gaikwad, too, hits in the same region and gives the strike back to Samson. Another single as Samson takes a quick single towards mid off. SIX! Gaikwad pulls the ball away into the stands over midwicket! Picked the length quickly. OUT! Duffy induces an outside edge and Padikkal grabs an easy catch at the first slip. Gaikwad is gone. He scores just 7 off 3 balls. Ayush Mhatre is the new man in. Takes a single off the first ball. Highest scores in RCB vs CSK IPL matches 1) RCB - 250/3 in 2026 in Bengaluru2) CSK - 226/6 in 2023 in Bengaluru3) RCB - 218/8 in 2023 in Bengaluru4) RCB - 218/5 in 2024 in Benglauru5) CSK - 216/4 in 2022 in Navi Mumbai Can CSK do the unthinkable? Chennai Super Kings will need to register the second-highest successful run chase ever in the IPL if it wants to chase 251 runs today. The highest chase in the IPL is Punjab Kings’ 262-run pursuit against KKR in 2024.CSK’s highest successful chase is just 206, achieved back in 2012 against RCB in Chepauk. In fact, two of CSK’s three 200-plus chases have come against RCB. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 250/3 in 20 overs Kamboj to bowl the final over. SIX! Wide yorker and carved behind point by Patidar for a maximum. Thumped back to the bowler by Patidar. Dot ball. A wide yorker again and driven by Patidar for a single. Good wide yorker again, and just a single for David. And yes, it is another yorker wide outside off and Patidar can only squeeze it away for a single. FOUR! Full on the legs, and flicked to deep midwicket. There was a catching opportunity for Ayush Mhatre but he lost the ball in the lights and let it go past the boundary. RCB smashes 97 runs in the last five overs to reach a record 250/3 in 20 overs. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 237/3 in 19 overs SIX! Ridiculous hitting from David. Overton pitches it full on leg-stump and David flicks it away over fine-leg. A couple more next ball as the ball runs away to fine-leg off David’s inside edge. FOUR! Short, David gets a top edge and the ball flies over Samson and to the boundary. SIX! In the slot outside off and David slams this over long-on for another maximum. That’s a 50 for David off just 15 balls!SIX! It is just raining sixes. Thumped straight down the ground by David and there is nowhere to hide now for the CSK bowlers. The score climbs to 231 and that is the highest score for RCB against CSK in IPL. SIX! Short and pulled away over square-leg and the ball has disappeared outside the stadium. 30 runs from that over, four sixes, and a four. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 207/3 in 18 overs Kamboj comes back. FOUR! Full toss wide outside off and slashed away to the boundary by David. In the slot on leg-stump, and David misses the big hit. Dot ball. A couple more for David as he digs the yorker out through extra-cover. Good wide yorker from Kamboj, and David can’t put bat on it. David, though, has reviewed that one, and wants it to be given wide. The third umpire rules it is a fair delivery and RCB loses the review. OUT! Cleaned him up, and David loses his leg-stump. Kamboj is pumped. Oh no! But Kamboj has overstepped and the buzzer goes off. David gets a lifeline. SIX! Full toss and hammered over long-on by David. Talk about insult to injury! The 50-run partnership is up between Patidar and David, off just 24 balls! Just a single to end the over and David will keep strike. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 193/3 in 17 overs Khaleel has been subbed out and in comes Kartik Sharma as CSK’s Impact Player. Noor will bowl his final over. A single through extra-cover for David to start the over. A bye for RCB as Patidar misses the reverse-sweep. SIX! A half-tracker angling away and David wallops this over long-off for a maximum. SIX! Still shortish and David has pulled this with brute force over deep midwicket for consecutive maximums. SIX! A hat-trick of sixes for David. Noor comes around the wicket, but that doesn’t change anything. Still back of a length but David rocks back a bit and hammers this over wide long-off. Cut away for a single by David to end the over. 40 runs from the last two overs. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 172/3 IN 16 overs Khaleel will bowl out now. Patidar makes room on the off-side and punches the ball over covers for a single. Hacked away to deep square-leg by David for one more. Slow and short, and Patidar misses it trying to ramp it over third-man. Patidar reviews it as he think it should be called a wide for height. Good review as it is called a wide. SIX! Crunched over extra-cover by Patidar and that’s a maximum. Patidar misses the hoick on leg-side, and there is a loud appeal for lbw. Not given and CSK reviews. However, DRS shows Patidar got a toe end of the bat on that and the crowd roars.FOUR! Width outside off and slashed behind point by Patidar for another boundary. SIX! That’s a huge maximum to end the over. Patidar picked it up off his hips and deposited the ball deep over midwicket. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 153/3 in 15 overs OUT! Overton comes back and removes Padikkal. The left-hander went for a cheeky scoop and loses his leg-stump. Overton is pumped, and why not! Devdutt Padikkal b Jamie Overton 50 (29b 5x4 2x6)In comes Tim David now. A couple of dot balls to start off, as Overton bowls with good pace. Three dot balls in a row now as David drives the ball back to the bowler, who stops the ball with his feet. Slashed over cover for a single and David is finally off the mark. Excellent over so far. Just one off it. A leg-bye to end the over as Patidar cannot connect the pull. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 151/2 in 14 overs SIX! Patidar greets Henry with a six over long-off and that’s the 50 partnership up off just 16 balls!Patidar puts the slower bouncer away through midwicket for a single. DROPPED! Gaikwad puts down a tough change at cover, and that’s a lifeline for Padikkal on 43; they come back for two. Bouncer is too high and called a wide. CSK has reviewed this, and the decision is overtuned. It is a fair delivery. Precious dot ball for CSK. FOUR! Width outside off and slashed over cover by Padikkal for a boundary. Pulled to deep midwicket by Padikkal for a single and that’s a 50 for him, off 28 balls. His second consecutive half-century this season. Time for a strategic time out! RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 137/2 in 13 overs Dube continues. He starts off with a wide outside off. Driven to sweeper cover by Padikkal for a single. SIX! Short ball, well-directed, but Patidar gets enough of a top edge for the ball to just sail over deep fine-leg. Tucked through midwicket now by Patidar for a single. SIX! Slower one, pushed outside off, and Padikkal stretches out and somehow gets enough connection to clear wide long-off. FOUR! This is beautifully carved behind point by Padikkal for another boundary. Excellent batting from the southpaw and the crowd is roaring. FOUR! Too full and this is drilled down the ground by Padikkal for another boundary. 23 runs from the Dube over and RCB are suddenly back on top of things. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 114/2 in 12 overs SIX! Patidar takes a step and glides this over cover for a magnificent maximum. SIX! Now Padikkal gets into the act. He steps out and clears long-on for another maximum. Noor Ahmed getting some rought treatment now. Good comeback by Noor, as he darts in a quicker one that goes off Padikkal’s front pad for one leg-bye. Pushed to long-off by Patidar for one more. Cut away to deep point by Padikkal for another single to end the over. RCB vs CSK Live Score: RCB 98/2 in 11 overs Shivam Dube into the attack. Slapped to cover by Salt for a dot first ball. Going down leg-side, and Salt flicks it for a single. Cut away by Padikkal for one more through point. OUT! Salt miscues the pull, and it is taken brilliantly by Noor Ahmed at deep square-leg. Good slower delivery that was dug into the pitch by Dube. Phil Salt c Noor Ahmad b Shivam Dube 46 (30b 3x4 2x6) Captain Rajat Patidar comes in next. He is off the mark with a single. FOUR! Short ball angling outside off, and Padikkal cuts it away to the third-man boundary. RCB vs CSK live score: RCB 91/1 in 10 overs Noor continues. Padikkal wants a quick single as he drives towards cover fielder but is sent back. A dot. Another dot in the same region. Quicker one by Noor and beats Padikkal who wanted to cut it. Now a single towards deep midwicket for Padikkal. Salt takes a single towards midwicket now. Padikkal attempts a sweep, the ball goes fine of the short fine leg fielder and the batters take a couple of runs to end the over. RCB vs CSK live score: RCB 87/1 in 9 overs Jamie Overton into the attack. Padikkal takes a single off the first ball towards deep square leg. Salt drives and the mid off fielder does well to keep it down to just a double. Timely dive to save the boundary. Salt takes a single the next ball towards deep covers. Padikkal lofts just over the cover fielder and takes a double. The outfield has been slow today. Padikkal moves across and picks the ball over short fine leg fielder for four! Smart shot. Another slash, this time towards deep third which will get him only a single. RCB 76/1 in 8 overs Noor Ahmad into the attack. Salt tries to slog him and somehow gets off balance and falls. A dot ball. A single next ball towards cover point fielder. Padikkal works the ball towards long on to give the strike back to Salt. SIX! Salt slog sweeps and ball goes way into the midwicket stand. Brilliant hit. Takes a single next ball towards deep covers.Padikkal takes a single to end the over. RCB vs CSK live score: RCB 65/1 in 7 overs Kamboj continues. Padikkal cuts towards deep point for a single. He wanted a second run but was denied by Salt. Bouncer to Salt and umpire thinks it too high, wide ball. Another dot ball as Salt’s drive is fielded by the cover fielder. SIX! Salt picks the length ball and clears the square leg fielder for a maximum! Easy pickings. Salt takes off for a single at covers and the fielder inside the circle misfields to gift another run. FOUR! Powerfully struck that. Pulled towards midwicket by Salt. A single to end the over. RCB 51/1 in 6 overs Khaleel Ahmed is back. Salt takes a double off the first ball. He was looking to ramp but couldn’t time it. Salt drives straight to cover fielder. Dot ball. Salt attempts to go past the mid on but can only get a single. Hasn’t been able to time the ball well today. Padikkal is beaten off the drive!Padikkal drives now towards deep point for a single. Salt smacks the ball wide of mid on and ends the PowerPlay with a four! RCB 43/1 in 5 overs Anshul Kamboj into the attack. Kohli comes down the track, hits towards mid on but can’t take a single.FOUR! Kohli slogs it away for four towards midwicket. OUT! Kohli is gone. Came down the track, Kohli goes for the pull and ends up skying the ball. Safely caught wide of long on. Kohli goes for 28 off 18 balls. Devdutt Padikal at three. Takes a single first ball. Salt gets an outside edge and ball goes JUST past Samson for four! A single to end the over. RCB 33/0 in 4 overs Henry again. Salt slogs over mid on. It’s too high and ball still doesn’t crosses the boundary. Just a single. SIX! Kohli launches over the midwicket region and into the stands. Lovely shot. First boundary for RCB. Henry bowls full and straight, Kohli launches straight but doesn’t have enough power, and takes a double.Kohli charges down the track, pulls and takes a double. What a lovely shot! Kohli charges down the track and drives the ball straight past the bowler for four. Kohli taps towards leg side and takes a single. 16 runs off the over. RCB vs CSK live score: RCB 17/0 in 3 overs Khaleel Ahmed continues. Length ball, Kohli tries to pull but doesn’t time it well. Can only get a single on that occasion. Salt once again gets a thick outside edge towards deep point and gets a single.DROPPED! Kohli is dropped by Shivam Dube! Kohli launches high in the air, towards long on. Dube is well set to take the catch, but ends up fumbling it. Two runs for RCB. Kohli takes a single the next ball, via leg bye. Salt takes off for a quick single and makes it on time. Kohli goes for a slog, misses the last ball. Still no boundary for RCB. RCB 11/0 in 2 overs Matt Henry from the other end. Phil Salt guides the ball towards deep third and takes a single. Short third for Kohli, he taps and takes a single, the fielder misfields it but lucky for CSK, no extra run added. Salt tries to slog, takes a thick outside edge and ball goes towards deep point for a single. Kohli pulls but a terrific diving effort at the deep square leg stops a certain boundary. RCB can only add a couple of runs on that occasion. Kohli comes down the track, loses shape but takes a quick single towards mid on. Salt smacks the ball straight to mid off; Henry finishes with a dot ball. RCB vs CSK live score: RCB 5/0 in 1 over Khaleel Ahmed with the new ball. Starts off with two dot balls, beating Phil Salt’s both inside and outside edges on the two occasions. Salt now makes room and lofts the ball over cover point and runs three. Fielder does well to stop the boundary. A run out missed! Kohli wanted to take a quick single and direct hit would have sent him back off the first ball! Full and Kohli lofts it straight. Not much power and Kohli will get a double towards long on region. Khaleel beats Kohli’s outside edge to finish the over. Good start for CSK. Pitch report The pitch has lot of cracks, but spinners won’t play a major role today. It has been historically better for the pacers. Overall, good for batting, reckon the experts. CSK Impact Subs Matthew Short, Akeal Hosein, Kartik Sharma, Ramakrishna Ghosh, Gurjapneet Singh. RCB Impact Subs Suyash Sharma, Jacob Bethell, Rasikh Salam Dar, Kanishk Chouhan, Venkatesh Iyer. CSK Playing XI Sanju Samson (wk), Ruturaj Gaikwad (c), Ayush Mhatre, Sarfaraz Khan, Shivam Dube, Prashant Veer, Jamie Overton, Noor Ahmad, Anshul Kamboj, Matt Henry, Khaleel Ahmed. RCB Playing XI Phil Salt, Virat Kohli, Devdutt Padikkal, Rajat Patidar (c), Jitesh Sharma (wk), Tim David, Romario Shepherd, Krunal Pandya, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Abhinandan Singh, Jacob Duffy. No changes for CSK Chennai Super Kings captain Ruturaj Gaikwad confirms that there are no changes in his team for today’s match. There are also no changes in the RCB camp, says skipper Rajat Patidar. Toss Chennai Super Kings won the toss and elected to bowl. Will the toss favour Ruturaj today? Chennai Super Kings captain Ruturaj Gaikwad has lost both tosses this season, resulting in his team losing both those contests. With teams overwhelmingly choosing to bowl first at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, will the toss today be crucial in deciding CSK’s fortunes this season? Let’s find out soon, with the toss coming up shortly. Milestone loading for Bhuvneshwar RCB’s Bhuvneshwar Kumar is just one wicket away from becoming the second bowler in IPL history to pick 200 scalps in the tournament. He currently has 199 wickets in 191 matches, and is only behind leg-spinner Yuzvendra Chahal in the top wicket-takers’ list. Chahal has picked 224 wickets in 176 matches. Players to watch out for Jacob Duffy: New Zealand pacer Jacob Duffy had dented Sunrisers Hyderabad inside the PowerPlay with three wickets. With Chennai Super Kings’ top order not in the best of form, Duffy will pose a significant threat to the visitors. Sarfaraz Khan: Hecould not really cement his position in the IPL since making his debut in 2015. However, his T20 stocks seem to have turned a corner this year. His quickfire 12-ball 32 from No. 6 against Punjab Kings gave CSK the impetus to breach the 200-run mark. A promotion in the batting order could help CSK tide over its middle overs slowdown, while also giving the in-form Sarfaraz more time in the middle. CSK at a historical disadvantage against RCB Chennai Super Kings will have to flip the script and overcome recent history if it wants to beat RCB today. CSK has lost its last three matches against the Royal Challengers, with its last win coming in 2024 at Chepauk. Meanwhile, the last time the Super Kings beat RCB in Bengaluru was in 2023, when they won a high-scoring thriller by eight runs. Probable playing XI CSK: Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ayush Mhatre, Sanju Samson, Kartik Sharma, Sarfaraz Khan, Shivam Dube, Prashant Veer, Akeal Hosein/ Matt Henry, Noor Ahmad, Khaleel Ahmed, Anshul Kamboj Probable playing XI RCB: Virat Kohli, Phil Salt, Devdutt Padikkal, Rajat Patidar, Romario Shepherd, Jitesh Sharma, Tim David, Krunal Pandya, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Jacob Duffy, Abhinandan Singh/ Mangesh Yadav Some leeway for the spinners? Since IPL 2023, the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium has registered the second-best overall run rate amongst venues that have hosted at least 20 matches. Teams have scored at 9.73 runs per over since the start of 2023 in the IPL. While run rates have skyrocketed, the spinners have come into play increasingly, despite the venue’s small boundaries. In IPL 2025, the spinners logged an economy rate of 8.26, while the pacers went at 9.23 runs per over. However, seam bowling remains the more predominant wicket-taking option here. Who is leading the points table? Rajasthan Royals currently leads the points table with four points in two games. It is tied with Delhi Capitals and Punjab Kings who also have two wins out of two games. RCB is fourth with one win in one game while CSK is last with two losses out of two. Will MS Dhoni play today? Highly unlikely. CSK had already issued a statement saying Dhoni won’t be available for at least the first two weeks of the season. Expect him to remain unavailable for this fixture as well. Jitesh: RCB is chasing the title, not defending it “We are hungry like we were last year. Lots of people have forgotten that we are champions. This is a new season. But we have the confidence that we have achieved something. With that confidence, we are going forward,” Jitesh Sharma said ahead of today’s match against CSK. Win toss, bowl, win match? The M. Chinnaswamy Stadium has a reputation for favouring teams batting second. So much so that the last time a team opted to bat first at this venue was way back in 2017. On that occasion, RCB beat Delhi Daredevils by 15 runs. Since that match, teams winning the toss have opted to bowl first here in 41 matches in a row. However, the results here don’t really validate this bias. In the last 10 IPL games here, it is 50-50 between teams batting first and second. Will we see any debutants today? In the last match, Abhinandan Singh made his debut for RCB. In this game, left-arm pacer Mangesh Yadav is touted to play his first game in the IPL for Royal Challengers. We’ll soon find out, whether RCB make any changes for this match. Should CSK bat first again today? The M. Chinnaswamy Stadium has been a mixed bag for Chennai Super Kings in the IPL. The Super Kings have won six matches at the venue, while also losing as many. Of their six wins here, the Super Kings have batted first in four of them. Meanwhile, five of their six defeats in Bengaluru have come while batting second. Thus, batting first has historically favoured the Super Kings at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium. However, with their first two defeats in this season coming while batting first, it will be an interesting dilemma for the Super Kings, in case they win the toss. Kohli holds the edge against Khaleel Virat Kohli has a favourable match-up against CSK’s new-ball operator Khaleel Ahmed. Kohli has smashed the left-arm pacer for 46 runs in 25 balls, registering a strike rate of 184. Meanwhile, Kohli has been dismissed only once by Khaleel in six innings. If RCB’s talisman can continue his rich vein of form against Khaleel, expect RCB to get off to another flier today. All eyes on Dewald Brevis Dewald Brevis missed the first two games for Chennai Super Kings, nursing a side strain. CSK hasn’t given any update regarding his match fitness for this match as well. Chennai will hope he regains hit fitness soon given how poor the team’s middle order has been so far this season. RCB vs CSK: A clash of philosophies The RCB vs CSK contest is a clash of philosophies. While RCB has been the third-most aggressive team with the bat in the PowerPlay since IPL 2025, going at 9.97 runs an over, CSK has only managed a run rate of 8.63, the second-lowest. While RCB averages a whopping 50.42 in the PowerPlay, CSK loses a wicket every 24.38 runs in the first six overs. These contrasting PowerPlays could well decide the fate of the match. Will Josh Hazlewood play today? Josh Hazlewood missed the first match of the season against Sunrisers Hyderabad. While has been training with the team but only did light warmups on the eve of this marquee clash. There has been no sign from the camp as well of his availability for today’s match. Can Samson find form today? After two single-digit scores, the focus will be on Sanju Samson and his ability to bounce back. However, he will have his task cut out against Bhuvneshwar Kumar, who has dismissed Samson four times in 19 innings, while conceding 120 runs in 95 balls. However, Samson’s opening partner, Ruturaj Gaikwad, has never been dismissed by the RCB spearhead in T20s. In six innings, Ruturaj has scored 69 runs off 48 balls against Bhuvneshwar. Who has scored most runs in RCB vs CSK rivalry? Probably the easiest of the guesses: Virat Kohli. In 35 innings, Kohli has amassed 1160 runs at an average of 37.41. His strike rate against Chennai Super Kings is 127.61, with a highest score of 90 not out. Who has taken most wickets in RCB vs CSK rivalry? Ravindra Jadeja with 18 wickets in 22 innings. None of the top three bowlers in this rivalry play for either of the teams now: Jadeja, Dwayne Bravo (17) and Albie Morkel (16). What happened the last time RCB and CSK faced off? The prelude to tonight’s contest was a thriller. Last year, the two rivals faced off at this same venue, with RCB beating CSK by the barest of margins. The two-run win was set up by Yash Dayal’s stunning last over. The left-arm pacer defended 14 runs in the last over and dismissed MS Dhoni to consign the Super Kings to an agonising defeat. The young Ayush Mhatre announced himself with a brilliant 94, while the evergreen Ravindra Jadeja smashed an unbeaten 77, but all in vain. For RCB, Virat Kohli, Jacob Bethell and Romario Shepherd struck fifties, helping their team to 213/5. The big game beckons!
